weekly_outcome: Students can greet someone, say their name, ask how a person is, respond politely, and introduce a friend.
weekly_outcome_telugu: విద్యార్థులు అభివాదం చేయడం, తమ పేరు చెప్పడం, యోగక్షేమాలు అడగడం, మర్యాదగా సమాధానం ఇవ్వడం మరియు స్నేహితుడిని పరిచయం చేయడం నేర్చుకుంటారు.

lessons.title: Hello and good morning
lessons.objective: Greet a teacher or friend at the right time.
lessons.objective_telugu: సరైన సమయంలో ఉపాధ్యాయుడిని లేదా స్నేహితుడిని అభివాదం చేయడం.

teacher_guidance.warm_up: Smile, wave, and say ‘Hello’ to three students. Ask the class to copy the gesture and words.
teacher_guidance.model: Point to a morning picture and model ‘Good morning’. Contrast it with an afternoon picture.
teacher_guidance.guided_practice: Show a time-of-day card. Students choose and say the matching greeting together.
teacher_guidance.pair_practice: Pairs greet each other twice: once as school begins and once after lunch.
teacher_guidance.common_errors: If students say only ‘Morning’, recast gently as ‘Good morning’. Keep the final /g/ in morning soft and clear.
teacher_guidance.home_practice: Say ‘Good morning’ to a family member the next morning.

questions.prompt: School begins in the morning. What do you say to your teacher?
questions.prompt_telugu: ఉదయం పాఠశాల మొదలైంది. ఉపాధ్యాయుడికి ఏమని చెబుతారు?
questions.feedback: We say ‘Good morning’ at the beginning of the school day.

questions.prompt: Choose the friendly greeting.
It is after lunch. Which greeting fits?
questions.prompt_telugu: మధ్యాహ్న భోజనం తర్వాత ఏ అభివాదం సరిపోతుంది?

lessons.title: My name is…
lessons.objective: Introduce yourself using a complete sentence.
lessons.objective_telugu: పూర్తి వాక్యంతో మీ గురించి పరిచయం చేసుకోవడం.

teacher_guidance.warm_up: Hold a name card and say ‘My name is Lakshmi’. Students repeat with their own names.
teacher_guidance.model: Tap your chest for ‘My’, point to the name card for ‘name’, and speak the full sentence slowly.
teacher_guidance.guided_practice: Use four familiar student names. The class completes ‘My name is ___’ aloud.
teacher_guidance.pair_practice: Student A asks ‘What is your name?’ Student B answers ‘My name is ___.’ Then swap.
teacher_guidance.common_errors: Correct ‘I name…’ by recasting the full pattern ‘My name is…’. Do not over-explain grammar at this age.
teacher_guidance.home_practice: Introduce yourself in English to one family member.

questions.prompt: How do you introduce yourself?
questions.prompt_telugu: మీ గురించి మీరు ఎలా పరిచయం చేసుకుంటారు?
questions.feedback: ‘My name is…’ is the complete sentence.

questions.prompt: What question asks for a person’s name?
questions.prompt_telugu: ఒకరి పేరు అడగడానికి ఏ ప్రశ్న ఉపయోగిస్తారు?
questions.feedback_telugu: మర్యాదగా ‘వాట్ ఈజ్ యువర్ నేమ్?’ అని అడగండి.

questions.prompt: Complete: I ___ Harshini.

lessons.title: How are you?
lessons.objective: Ask how someone is and understand a simple response.
lessons.objective_telugu: ఒకరి యోగక్షేమాలు అడిగి, సరళమైన సమాధానాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడం.

teacher_guidance.warm_up: Use happy, okay, and tired face cards. Students copy the expression and name the feeling in Telugu first.
teacher_guidance.model: Ask a confident student ‘How are you?’ and model ‘I am fine, thank you.’
teacher_guidance.guided_practice: Hold up a feeling card. Students answer together using ‘I am ___.’
teacher_guidance.pair_practice: Pairs ask and answer twice, changing the feeling word on the second turn.
teacher_guidance.common_errors: If students answer only ‘fine’, accept it first and expand naturally to ‘I am fine.’
teacher_guidance.home_practice: Ask a family member ‘How are you?’ and listen to the answer.

questions.prompt: Which sentence asks about someone’s wellbeing?
questions.feedback: ‘How are you?’ asks how a person feels.
questions.feedback_telugu: ‘హౌ ఆర్ యూ?’ ఒకరు ఎలా ఉన్నారో అడుగుతుంది.

questions.prompt: Rohan feels good. What can he say?
questions.feedback: Use the complete response ‘I am fine.’
questions.feedback_telugu: ‘ఐ యామ్ ఫైన్’ అనే పూర్తి సమాధానాన్ని ఉపయోగించండి.

questions.prompt: Choose the polite two-line conversation.
questions.audio: How are you? I am fine, thank you.
questions.pronunciation_telugu: హౌ ఆర్ యూ? ఐ యామ్ ఫైన్, థాంక్ యూ.
choices: How are you? — I am fine, thank you.
questions.feedback: The answer matches the question and includes ‘thank you’.
questions.feedback_telugu: సమాధానం ప్రశ్నకు సరిపోతుంది మరియు ‘థాంక్ యూ’ కూడా ఉంది.

lessons.title: Nice to meet you
lessons.objective: Respond politely when meeting someone for the first time.

key_phrases.meaning_telugu: మిమ్మల్ని కలవడం కూడా నాకు ఆనందంగా ఉంది.

teacher_guidance.warm_up: Pretend to meet a new student. Smile, make eye contact, and say ‘Nice to meet you.’
teacher_guidance.model: Demonstrate both turns: ‘Nice to meet you’ and ‘Nice to meet you too.’
teacher_guidance.guided_practice: The class repeats each line with a friendly voice and a small wave.
teacher_guidance.pair_practice: Pairs exchange names and the two ‘Nice to meet you’ lines.
teacher_guidance.common_errors: Students may omit ‘to’. Clap the rhythm: Nice / to / meet / you.
teacher_guidance.home_practice: Practise the two-line exchange with a sibling or family member.

questions.prompt: You meet a new classmate. What is polite to say?
questions.prompt_telugu: మీరు కొత్త సహపాఠిని కలిశారు. మర్యాదగా ఏమని చెబుతారు?
questions.feedback: ‘Nice to meet you’ is friendly and polite.
questions.feedback_telugu: ‘నైస్ టు మీట్ యూ’ అనేది స్నేహపూర్వకమైన, మర్యాదపూర్వకమైన మాట.

questions.prompt: Someone says ‘Nice to meet you.’ Choose your reply.
questions.prompt_telugu: ఎవరైనా ‘నైస్ టు మీట్ యూ’ అన్నారు. మీ సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి.
questions.feedback: Add ‘too’ to return the friendly greeting.
questions.feedback_telugu: అదే స్నేహపూర్వక భావాన్ని తిరిగి చెప్పడానికి ‘టూ’ జోడించండి.

questions.prompt: Complete: This is my ___.

lessons.title: Let’s have a conversation
lessons.objective: Use the week’s phrases in a short conversation.
lessons.objective_telugu: ఈ వారం నేర్చుకున్న వాక్యాలతో చిన్న సంభాషణ చేయడం.

teacher_guidance.warm_up: Review the five key expressions with gesture cards and quick whole-class repetition.
teacher_guidance.model: Perform a four-line conversation with a student from greeting through ‘Nice to meet you.’
teacher_guidance.guided_practice: Build the conversation one line at a time. Point to visual cues instead of translating every line.
teacher_guidance.pair_practice: Pairs perform the complete conversation, then change partners and repeat with new names.
teacher_guidance.common_errors: Focus on confidence and meaning. Correct only one important pattern per turn so children keep speaking.
teacher_guidance.home_practice: Perform the full conversation for a family member.

questions.prompt: Which line should begin a conversation?
questions.feedback: Begin with a greeting such as ‘Hello’.

questions.prompt: Put the ideas in a natural order.
questions.audio: Hello. My name is Sai. How are you?
questions.pronunciation_telugu: హలో. మై నేమ్ ఈజ్ సాయి. హౌ ఆర్ యూ?
questions.feedback: Greet first, introduce yourself, and then ask how the person is.
questions.feedback_telugu: మొదట అభివాదం చేసి, మీ పేరు చెప్పి, తర్వాత వారు ఎలా ఉన్నారో అడగండి.

questions.prompt: Complete the conversation: ‘How are you?’ — ‘___’
questions.feedback: This is a complete and polite response.

weekend_test.title: Week 1 Challenge
weekend_test.instructions: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.prompt: It is 9:00 a.m. What do you say?
Choose the correct introduction.
Which question asks for a name?
Answer: How are you?
You meet a new friend. What do you say?
questions.prompt_telugu: మీరు కొత్త స్నేహితుడిని కలిశారు. ఏమని చెబుతారు?

questions.prompt: Complete: This is my ___.
It is 2:00 p.m. Choose the greeting.
Reply to: Nice to meet you.
questions.prompt_telugu: సమాధానం ఇవ్వండి: నైస్ టు మీట్ యూ.

questions.prompt: Choose the complete sentence.
Which conversation is natural?
questions.audio: Hello. What is your name? My name is Rohan.
questions.pronunciation_telugu: హలో. వాట్ ఈజ్ యువర్ నేమ్? మై నేమ్ ఈజ్ రోహన్.
choices: Hello. — What is your name? — My name is Rohan.
Good night. — I name? — Fine book.
How are you? — My pencil is morning.
